Artifact: Tab.app live screen-context proof
Ticket: PER-416
Source commit: 5776b82bb7b334bac366e0bdc27b9c72eccc4afc

From the repository root, verify the deterministic suite:

  /usr/bin/xcodebuild -project Tab/Tab.xcodeproj -scheme Tab \
    -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
    -destination 'platform=macOS' test

Build the package with the stable development-signed identity used for macOS
Screen Recording permission:

  TAB_SIGNING_MODE=development Tab/scripts/build-app.sh

The script writes Tab.app beside this file. It defaults to development team
L5YX8CH3F5; set TAB_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM to another team identifier if reproducing
under a different Apple developer account. Deep signature verification runs as
part of the script.

Launch the opt-in context sidecar using the exact packaged app:

  /usr/bin/open -na "$(pwd)/Tab/dist/Tab.app" \
    --args --screen-context-log

On first use, grant Screen Recording to Tab in System Settings and relaunch the
same packaged identity if macOS requests it. Capture, visual change detection,
and Vision OCR run locally without an API key. Remote analysis remains off
until the operator manually enters an OpenRouter key and enables Luna in the
sidecar. The prototype keeps that key in process memory only; do not add a key
to this recipe, the environment, source control, or logs.

Expected verification for this source commit:

- 37 tests pass with zero failures.
- Tab.app identifies as app.usefence.tab and passes deep codesign verification.
- The development build has sandbox, network-client, and get-task-allow
  entitlements; it does not request Accessibility, Automation, microphone, or
  audio permissions.
